text:
aj (Sales): Quick kickoff sync for the Nimbus Systems pilot — creating an async thread so we have a single source of truth. Goal: 6-week pilot. Success criteria: P95 <= 200ms for core routes, SSO + audit logs enabled, ingest 50k messages for QA. Timeline draft here: https://redwood.example.com/pilot/nimbus :spiral_calendar:

maria (SE): Thanks — quick Q: do we have a Nimbus infra contact for VPC peering / IP allowlist? They asked for CIDR and expected ASN. cc @lee (PM) :raising_hand:

devon (Eng): I can own VPC peering + firewall rules. Need the network access ticket to be created (TKT-9812). ETA Wed EOD for initial config. I'll also loop in infra for route propagation. :white_check_mark:

lee (PM): Ownership summary: devon -> network/infra + peering, maria -> SE integration + test data onboarding, aj -> customer comms. Milestones: Week1 peering, Week2 schema + ingest, Week4 load tests, Week6 review + handover. Will update calendar invites.

maria (SE): For schema I uploaded a draft: https://redwood.example.com/docs/pilot-nimbus/schema-v1.md. Sending sample payloads to their SRE today. Also requesting code review for ingest lambda PR `#4321` (devon).

devon (Eng): PR `#4321` is open and ready for review, requested from @alex. Quick config snippet for the environ vars I used in the branch:
```
PILOT_MODE=true
NIMBUS_BUCKET=nimbus-pilot
MAX_INGEST_THREADS=4
```

aj (Sales): Nimbus requires SSO via SAML — any blockers on our side? Also finance needs an estimate for pilot credits by Friday so they can approve billing terms. :money_with_wings:

lee (PM): @mira can you confirm a pilot credit cap of $5k? Also we need permission to enable audit logs with 90d retention for their compliance team.

mira (Finance): $5k cap is fine from finance side. Please include an estimated token/usage volume so we can sign off on cost.

maria (SE): Estimate is ~2M tokens across the 6 weeks (peak days ~200k). I'll add a token breakdown to the pilot doc and tag finance.

devon (Eng): Network ticket TKT-9812 updated: https://jira.redwood.internal/browse/TKT-9812 — peering scheduled Thu 09:30 local, will post config and route table entries after completion.

aj (Sales): Can we draft a canary/rollback plan for model changes during the pilot? Nimbus asked about automatic fallbacks and customer-facing messaging if we switch models.

maria (SE): I'll draft a rollback + incident playbook and add it to the pilot doc. It will include: automated fallback to smaller model variant, rate-limiting thresholds, and a one-click revert in the console. I'll ping devon for the automated fallback config.

oncall-bot: Reminder created — recurring async check-in Tuesday 10:00 AM.

lee (PM): Nice — next async check-in Tue 10:00. If any blockers before then, drop a note here or escalate to oncall. Closing action items: devon -> finish peering (TKT-9812), maria -> update docs + token breakdown, aj -> pricing/credits with customer, mira -> finalize finance approval. :thumbsup:
